headline: Upside risk to the guidance

highlights: Management retained its FY27 guidance of 8–10% revenue growth, 8.5–9.0% EBITDA margin and INR 220–250bn order inflows, which we believe is conservative, leaving room for upside.

On the balance sheet front, trade receivables declined to INR 27.0bn and unbilled revenue moderated to INR 71.7bn, while improving JJM collections are expected to support working capital and enable debt normalisation by FY27-end.
NCC's standalone order book remains robust at INR 712.9bn (~3.5x TTM revenue), with the company having achieved ~50% of its FY27 order inflow guidance, including October awards.
Key monitorables remain sustained order inflows and a ramp-up in execution.
valuation: Management retained its FY27 guidance of 8–10% revenue growth, 8.5–9.0% EBITDA margin and INR 220–250bn order inflows, which we believe is conservative, leaving room for upside.
watch: Key monitorables remain sustained order inflows and a ramp-up in execution.

The order book remains well diversified across segments, led by Buildings (28%), followed by Transportation (20%), Electrical T&D (15%), Mining (15%), Water & Railways (15%) and Irrigation & Others (7%), limiting concentration risk.
